mandate: C422 — test the price-only ZCRPATH: zero-crossing rate of the intrawindow cumulative-return (price-revisit) path stat-arb family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (1296 pre-registered configs). Per-bar primitives: perp_close real 5m kline close; log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|. Over fixed intrinsic window W=256 trailing returns X=r_i[t-W+1..t]: C_j=sum_{m=0..j} X_m (cumulative-return path, j=0..W-1); crossings=#{j in 1..W-1: C_{j-1}*C_j < 0}; zcr_path[i,t]=crossings/(W-1); zcr_asym[i,t]=(late-half crossings - early-half crossings)/(W-1). NaN if t<W or any NaN/non-finite in the W-bar span (global across assets) or not finite. Seasonal baseline = trailing mean/std at same (weekday,tod) bucket from history strictly before bar t (causal shift(1)), NaN-aware, excluding NaN obs. Signals: 2 real (zcr_path_dev, zcr_asym_dev) + 2 placebos (phase-randomized surrogates, never edges). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (taker=fee+slip; maker_blend=0.5*fee+slip). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, signal-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: metric NaN unless sufficient finite obs; seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0.

data_quality.note: metric NaN share dominated by finite-obs requirements (t<W=256 or NaN in trailing W-bar window).

methodology.raw_features: log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0) from real strictly-positive perp_close; abs_ret=|log_return|.
methodology.primitives: fixed intrinsic window W=256 trailing log-returns X=r_i[t-W+1..t]; C_j=sum_{m=0..j} X_m (cumulative-return path, j=0..W-1); crossings=#{j in 1..W-1: C_{j-1}*C_j < 0}; zcr_path=crossings/(W-1); zcr_asym=(late-half crossings - early-half crossings)/(W-1).
methodology.signals: zcr_path/zcr_asym over fixed W=256; score=-(v-m)/sd with m/sd trailing same-bucket mean/std (min_periods=3, excluding NaN, causal shift(1)); cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; taker = fee+slip; maker_blend = 0.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 1296 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: mean |OOS net| per signal across all its configs; shares=|mean|/sum(|means|) over all 4 signals incl. placebos; dominant must be a real (non-placebo) signal with share >= 0.5 for attribution_ok.
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.placebo: phase-randomized surrogate via FFT phase randomization + rank restoration to original marginal; deterministic seed recorded; same marginal distribution, destroyed temporal alignment.
methodology.zcrpath_vectorization_note: return matrix R=(T,10) built once; per asset, sliding_window_view over W-bar windows in bounded chunks; C=cumsum(window); zero crossings = sum(C[:-1]*C[1:] < 0); zcr_path=crossings/(W-1); zcr_asym=(late-half - early-half crossings)/(W-1); global W-bar finiteness gate; validated against brute-force per-window loop with explicit cumsum + crossing count, maxdiff < 1e-9 in tests.
